purpose: Teach: レター/高性能/撮ら/商用/出所/明細/否め/バージョンアップ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者への、感謝のレター、ちゃんと書いておけ。
lines.en: Ren, make sure you write that thank-you letter to the researchers properly.
lines.style: Even-handed and direct. No edge—just the expectation of follow-through. Measured pause after the name. Brief, clear closing on the instruction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。高性能の実験装置、研究室、新しく、入りました。
lines.en: Yes. The new high-performance lab equipment just arrived in the research room.
lines.style: Quick affirmation followed by straightforward fact. Slight formality—he's reporting, not chatting. Steady delivery, no enthusiasm, just accuracy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文用の写真、許可なく、撮らないようにな。
lines.en: Don't take photographs for the paper without getting permission first.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. Light weight on 「許可」—the word that matters. Not lecturing; stating a line that needs holding. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。商用利用の研究、申請、慎重にいたします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful and thorough about filing the application for commercial use of the research.
lines.style: Respectful commitment without over-apologizing. Slight formality on the word 「慎重に」. Even pace, genuine intent. Not defensive—just clear.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 参考文献の出所、論文に、必ず、明記しろ。
lines.en: Make sure the sources for all references are clearly stated in the paper.
lines.style: Non-negotiable but not unkind. Slight tap of weight on 「必ず」—this is the rule. Clean, economical delivery. The tone of someone who's seen papers rejected for this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経費明細、研究室、しっかり、保管しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm keeping detailed expense records properly filed in the lab.
lines.style: Steady, almost relieved that he can confirm this. Matter-of-fact delivery on the logistics. No pride in it—just competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の競争、激しさ、否めない時代だな、若い君も。
lines.en: The competition in research is fierce these days, especially for someone young like you.
lines.style: Quieter here. Not threatening—observational. Slight weariness that comes from knowing the field. A moment of candor underneath the instruction. Gentle but real.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究ソフト、バージョンアップ、定期的に、行います。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to update the research software regularly on schedule.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Quieter than before—absorbing what was just said. Not just confirming task, but acknowledging the larger weight beneath it. Slight fade on the close.
